newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins calm as Eurobond issue priced in.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins calm as Eurobond issue priced in.

text.p: Russian MinFin bonds opened slightly lower and held steady in quiet early trading despite news of the terms of Russia's second Eurobond which had already been priced in, pushing up MinFins over the last few days, dealers said on Thursday.
The mark two billion mark seven-year nine-percent Eurobond was priced to yield 370 basis points over Bunds.
"No moves have been seen so far. Trading started from lower levels than yesterday," Avtobank dealer Alla Zakharova said.
"The market could already price in the (Eurobond issue) news, having risen in the last few days," she added.
